A declared colour-blind mode is not a palette mode.

## Examples

### GX019 colour-blind-mode / Examples / A mode without a palette fires #1 (line 22) (fire)

```toml
[game]
coverage = []
```

### GX019 colour-blind-mode / Examples / A declared palette mode is clean #2 (line 30) (clean)

```toml
[game]
coverage = []
colour_blind_modes = ["deuteranopia"]

[palette.modes.deuteranopia]
ink = "#ffffff"
```
